messages:
Olivia (Pricing): Quick heads-up — we plan to roll the new pricing schedule next Tue 2026-04-12. Key changes: normalized commit tiers, updated bundle discounts, and APAC regional adjustments. Need alignment on grandfathering + special-terms workflow. Docs: https://redwood.ai/pricing/v2-updates
Liam (Deal Desk): Thanks — can you confirm the effective time of day? We need cutover windows for quotes/commit capture. Also: will old SKUs be accepted for 30 days after rollout? :thinking_face:
Olivia (Pricing): Effective 00:00 UTC. We'll accept old SKUs for 21 days for quoting only (no new commit credits), except for explicit grandfather exceptions approved by deal desk.
Raj (Presales): For active POCs, how should we price? We typically give demo discounts that translate into starter commits. Will POC discounts map to the new bundle tiers automatically?
Olivia (Pricing): Good Q. Short answer: POC discounts stay as one-off credits unless the AE requests convert-to-commit before the cutover. If conversion happens after cutover, we'll map to closest new tier and apply a pro-rated commit credit. I'll add examples to the FAQ.
Emma (AE): We have two deals in negotiation (APAC & EMEA). If a customer signs a 12-mo LOI before cutover but we bill after, which pricing applies?
Liam (Deal Desk): Signed LOI = pricing at signer date unless explicitly noted in contract. If invoice date differs, finance will still honor the LOI terms. I'll flag finance for exceptions.
Maya (Legal): Please ensure any grandfathering language is captured in the template amendment. We need a short clause that ties grandfather treatment to: (a) LOI signed date, or (b) Deal Desk approved exception id.
Olivia (Pricing): Noted — Maya can you draft a 2-line clause? I'll paste into the pricing FAQ.
Maya (Legal): On it. Draft: "Customer pricing is governed by the signed LOI or an approved Deal Desk exception (reference ID). New pricing applies to new commitments after the effective date"
Support (Engineering): Slight ops question: changing SKU IDs will break some existing CPQ mappings. Any chance we keep SKU aliases so integrations keep working?
Olivia (Pricing): We will publish SKU aliases for 60 days. New SKU -> alias mapping will be in the CSV export.
BuildBot: New file uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/pricing/v2/sku-mapping.csv (internal)
Liam (Deal Desk): Workflow check — for exceptions: Deal Desk gets a JIRA, we attach approvals and exception id, pricing team signs off, legal signs the clause. Who approves >25% off list?
Olivia (Pricing): Discounts >25% require VP Sales + Pricing sign-off. Anything >40% requires Exec approval. Use the standard exception template.
Emma (AE): Can we get a quick cheat-sheet I can send to customers? I need 1-pager for AMs today.
Olivia (Pricing): I'll produce a one-pager with 3 examples (POC conversion, LOI pre-sign, APAC region delta) and a short flow for exceptions. Expect it by EOD.
Raj (Presales): Small ask — can we freeze demo instance quota changes for two days around cutover? Want to avoid perf noise from plan changes.
Support (Engineering): We can freeze quota changes for 48h surrounding the cutover window. Ops will announce maintenance too.
Liam (Deal Desk): One last item — will legacy committed customers get any transition credit for model upgrades tied to the new bundles?
Olivia (Pricing): We'll honor a one-time transition credit equal to the difference between legacy commit price and equivalent new bundle for the first billing period. Outline will be in the FAQ.
Olivia (Pricing): Thanks all — action items: Maya to draft clause, Olivia to publish FAQ + 1-pager, Liam to confirm Deal Desk exception process doc, Support to schedule quota freeze, BuildBot to publish SKU CSV. Ping me directly for urgent exceptions :thumbsup:
Emma (AE): :thumbsup: got it
Liam (Deal Desk): will create JIRA board and post link when ready
BuildBot: JIRA project created: PRICING-EXCEPTIONS (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/PRICING-EXCEPTIONS)
Olivia (Pricing): Closing thread — I'll post final rollout announcement and internal FAQ tomorrow morning 08:00 PT. If you need anything sooner, DM me.
